about.title: Building software, one commit at a time
about.p1: I'm a Systems Engineering student at Universidad Católica de Córdoba and a self-driven full-stack developer. I've been writing code since 2017 and logged 1,300+ contributions on GitHub in the past year.
about.p2: I've shipped a production website for a real local business, completed technical challenges end-to-end, and built full-stack projects with automated tests and CI pipelines — from React and Next.js frontends to Node, Express and Python backends.

projects.title: Things I've built
projects.wsChat.desc: Real-time chat app built with Next.js 16 and Socket.IO — live messaging, online users, and join/leave notifications served from a single custom Node server.
projects.vargas.desc: Production marketing site for Vargas, a family-run produce wholesaler in Córdoba. Next.js App Router, hand-rolled Tailwind styling, custom fonts.
projects.bugster.desc: Technical challenge webapp that classifies any idea as "million-dollar" or "pyramid scheme", with Supabase-powered authentication.
projects.xionico.desc: Full-stack challenge: an Angular 19 frontend with Google Maps and a Python backend.
projects.tif.desc: Software Engineering III final project: React frontend, Express + MongoDB API, Jest test suites and CI pipeline scripts.
projects.uccNotas.desc: LaTeX and Markdown study notes covering Systems Engineering courses at Universidad Católica de Córdoba — my most-starred repository.
